title: UFOs appear at the time of the Manhattan Project

tellings.quote: you have to wonder at that time because that's when all the UFOs pop up.

plain: UFO sightings started to crowd in at the same moment the atomic bomb was being built in the 1940s, in Michels's reading. Talking about the film Oppenheimer and the physicists J. Robert Oppenheimer and Edward Teller, he says "you have to wonder" about that period, "because that's when all the UFOs pop up", hinting that the bomb and the sightings may be linked.
